question: Whether existing complete quartic Cayley/vertex-transitive censuses already exclude D3 orders>41 or D4 orders>104.

confirmed_cayley_census.scope: Complete pairwise-nonisomorphic connected simple 4-valent Cayley graphs of every order at most1025.
paper_locations: Preliminaries: all Cayley graphs connected; graphs simple undirected
confirmed_cayley_census.author_page_location: Census of tetravalent Cayley graphs, lines16–20

arithmetic_implication.meaning: Every possible quartic Cayley graph relevant to these two degree/diameter questions belongs to the complete census.
arithmetic_implication.not_implied: Completeness alone does not state the largest order at diameter<=3 or<=4 and does not by itself prove a negative bound.

diameter_extrema.status: Not confirmed from the small primary material read. The paper has no diameter analysis; no diameter-invariant table was obtained.

vertex_transitive_scope.status: No such full-VT census confirmed in this bounded scout.

confirmed_subclasses.class: quartic admitting a half-arc-transitive group action

vertex_transitive_scope.warning: Neither edge/arc-transitive subclass is the class of all vertex-transitive graphs; a generic Cayley graph need not be edge-transitive.

local_read_scope.sole_ledger_targeted_search: Only unrelated quartic source/group experiments surfaced; no prior global quartic census diameter exclusion found in the targeted read.
local_read_scope.NEXT_and_current_scope: Parent existing108-group batch remains independent of this source scout.

decision: Do not declare the108 Cayley experiment impossible from these citations alone. Future exhaustive new group enumeration should first use the already complete Cayley census or a verified diameter summary; this scout does not authorize that data computation or stop the already bounded108 batch.
